title: Growth Engineer, Open Source
text:
WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

SigNoz is an open source observability platform built on OpenTelemetry: logs, metrics and traces in one tool. It's designed for an era where agents and humans run observability together. We are a YC company with 32K+ GitHub stars, and revenue grew 2.5x in the last 12 months.


Thousands of teams run SigNoz on their own infrastructure, and many more install it every week. We want that number to be much bigger. Today we don't know where installs come from, a meaningful share of install attempts fail, and which channels bring our most loyal users


Your job is to grow open source adoption the engineering way: measure where installs come from, make installing SigNoz just work, and put SigNoz in front of developers wherever they start a project, including through the coding agents they now work with.


You will work directly with the founders and the engineers who build self-hosted SigNoz. We are looking for an engineer who loves distribution, not a marketer.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN



1. KNOW WHERE INSTALLS COME FROM

 - Build install-source tracking across every path: README, docs, install CLI, Helm charts, templates and marketplaces.

 - Run a weekly view of installs by source, and of the installs from each source that are still running a month later.

 - Use it to decide where to spend time, and to stop doing what doesn't bring users who stay.


2. MAKE INSTALLING SIGNOZ JUST WORK

 - Find out why install attempts fail, and fix the top causes with the open source pod: the install CLI, Docker Compose, Helm charts, resource defaults.

 - Cut the time from running the install command to seeing data in SigNoz.


3. DISTRIBUTION

 - Ship and maintain one-click templates and marketplace listings: PaaS platforms (Coolify, Railway, Render), cloud marketplaces (AWS, GCP, Azure, DigitalOcean, Hetzner) and Artifact Hub.

 - Make SigNoz the default observability backend in other projects' examples: OpenTelemetry demos, framework and LLM-framework docs, docker-compose starters.

 - Build integrations that bring new users in, with our integrations team.


4. CODING AGENTS

 - Make SigNoz the tool a coding agent installs when a developer asks it to "add observability": docs written for agents, a one-command install, our MCP server and agent skills.

 - Track how many installs agents run, and grow it.


5. LAUNCHES, WITH DEVREL

 - Plan and run launches each quarter (Hacker News, Reddit, GitHub), with DevRel writing and you building.

 - Feed DevRel the topics and comparisons that the install data says matter.





HOW THE ROLE GROWS

This role starts as a solo builder. You will write the code, the templates and the dashboards yourself.


Once we know which channels bring users who stay, the scope grows into running those channels at scale, with a second engineer or more DevRel time behind them.



WHO WE THINK FITS

 - 3 to 7 years as a software, DevOps or developer relations engineer at a product company.

 - You have grown adoption of an open source project or developer tool, and can show the chart: stars, installs, downloads or active users before and after.

 - You are hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes and Helm, and you write code (Go, Python, TypeScript or shell) to ship templates, scripts and integrations.

 - You have built distribution through an ecosystem: marketplace listings, templates, plugins or integrations that other people used.

 - You own a weekly number, and you can pull it with SQL.

 - You write clearly for developers: READMEs, docs, launch posts.

 - You work well alone and decide what to do next from data.


BONUS POINTS

 - A launch that hit the Hacker News front page, GitHub trending or a top r/selfhosted post

 - You maintain a popular self-hosted or open source project

 - Active in the OpenTelemetry, CNCF, homelab or self-hosting communities

 - Experience with observability tools, or with building for coding agents (MCP, agent docs)
